title: Masonry or concrete construction.
officialText: A thermal barrier is not required for foam plastic insulation installed in a masonry or concrete wall, floor or roof system where the foam plastic insulation is covered on each face by a minimum of 1 inch (25 mm) thickness of masonry or concrete.
